{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Show the list of duplicate patient IDs
duplicate_ids = df.loc[duplicate_patients, 'patient_id'].unique()

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient to see if there's a higher one
dup_info = df.loc[duplicate_patients].groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Report results
dup_count, duplicate_ids, dup_info"}
